title: lightly laced norwegian cheese gratin
description: a pungent, fluffy, energizing norwegian dish featuring cheese slices, clay-pot-cook, no onion no garlic friendly
instructions: butter a 9-inch springform pan and set aside.
in a medium bowl, whisk together the gjetost cheese, brown cheese, baker's cheese, sour cream, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
stir in the chopped fresh dill.
dust the springform pan with flour and coat evenly.
pour the cheese mixture into the prepared pan.
cover the pan with foil and place it in a large clay pot or Dutch oven.
add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the pan.
cover the pot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
remove the pan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
run a knife around the edges of the pan to release the gratin, then invert onto a serving plate.
